newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Mar private machine orders fall 12.7 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Japan Mar private machine orders fall 12.7 pct m/m.

text.p: Japan's private-sector machinery orders, excluding those for machinery at electric power firms and for ships, fell a seasonally adjusted 12.7 percent in March from the previous month to 1.02 trillion yen, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Tuesday.
The EPA also said it expected private machinery orders in the same category to rise 4.5 percent in the April-June quarter from the previous quarter.
Orders fell 7.0 percent in the January-March quarter compared with an original EPA forecast of an 8.5 percent drop.
